title: Simulated IELTS Academic Task 1: Household Water Use and Conservation Habits
prompt:
The figure below combines a bar chart and a table. The bar chart shows average daily household water use per person in four countries in 2005 and 2020. The table shows the percentage of households in the same four countries that reported using three water-saving measures in 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有国家、年份与数据均为虚构，仅用于训练图表描述能力，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请注意：先整体浏览柱状图与表格，找出最显著的差异与变化趋势；用一段概述主要特征（不要逐条罗列数字）；主体段落按合理逻辑分组比较，例如按用水量高低或节水措施普及程度分组；准确引用图中数据并注意单位（升/人/日、百分比）；不要加入个人观点、原因分析或外部信息；控制在20分钟内完成，字数不少于150词。
